corrected.one_liner: Open-source command-line tool (mmdc) that renders Mermaid diagram definitions into SVG, PNG, or PDF, including from Markdown files.
corrected.auth_notes: Local tool with no hosted service and no authentication.
corrected.access_notes: Free MIT-licensed npm package (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli), also available as Docker/Podman images. No credentials needed. It runs locally; the README references puppeteer config and chromium known issues, indicating a headless browser dependency, so an agent toolkit needs Node plus a headless browser rather than calling a remote API.
corrected.blocker: No hosted REST API. It is a local CLI and Node library, and the Node API is not covered by semver. An agent toolkit has to run it in a sandbox or container. No official MCP server was found; community servers exist.
